title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
title_zh: EvoViM：面向延迟查询探索的递归自演化视觉智能体
abstract_en: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.
abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体在任务导向环境中展现出潜力，但当问题在探索结束后才提出时，智能体必须在不知道哪些细节有用的情况下保留视觉证据。EvoViM 让冻结的多模态模型从自身交互经验中构建并迭代一个统一的视觉程序，用于记忆与技能执行。该程序保留图像、直接在像素上计算，并通过程序操作决定如何在各项任务中使用视觉证据。在记忆演化过程中，同一模型回溯失败的交互轨迹，找出丢失或误用证据的操作并加以修订。它还会更新指导后续修订的笔记和分析工具，使后续迭代能够利用已有发现，避免重复尝试已证实无效的改动。研究使用三种多模态模型，在涵盖视觉匹配、空间回忆和序列决策的六项任务上评估 EvoViM，其中三项采用延迟查询。在留出回合中，EvoViM 的六项任务平均得分较主对比实验中最强的基线 AutoMem 高 31.3–47.6 分。仅根据初始环境说明一次性编写的程序表现明显更差，说明交互经验有助于改进视觉证据的保留与使用。代码和数据集见 https://evovim.github.io/。
key_points_zh: 延迟查询的核心难点是：智能体在探索时尚不知道要回答什么，却必须提前保留可能有用的视觉细节。
EvoViM 不更新模型参数，而是迭代统一的记忆与技能程序；程序保留图像并直接在像素上计算。
模型不仅修复导致证据丢失或误用的操作，还更新指导修订的笔记与分析工具，避免重复无效改动。
在三种多模态模型和六项任务的评估中，EvoViM 在留出回合的平均得分较 AutoMem 高 31.3–47.6 分；不利用交互经验的一次性编程方案表现明显更差。
